sources.referenceNote: reference 4495a1f has no steady R&D, no StartingRun abort and no Safe->R&D abort; gives no oracle here

notation.rb: first scan with both buttons FALSE after the BOTH gesture (release of the last button)
notation.u: first scan of C2 ON command / STO release (u1: C1 ON)
notation.a: T_SINGLE qualification scan of the green; g0+500 is q (observation), a <= g0+501

criteria.rule: a green that aborts StartingRun (V14-Q12) or Safe->R&D (V14-Q13) is a NEW attempt: both buttons continuously released T_RELEASE 2000 ms counted from rb, then green alone T_SINGLE 500 ms

boundaries.g0<=rb+1999: invalid: no abort in any scan for any hold; a new full 2 s release needed after it

forbidden: abort/descent/SafetyFault from a green pressed in [rb, rb+1999]
abort from the BOTH remainder (blue released, green kept from the gesture) of any duration
deferred execution of an invalid green
counting the 2 s from p, Q or u instead of rb
sources: V14-Q12 A (acts as the green of D-STARTINGRUN-GREEN-DOWN)

criteria.rule: abort already in progress at w is unreachable by a button: rb>=Q+1, w<=Q+900 (TD-06), earliest valid abort >= rb+2501 >= Q+2502 > w; even without clearing a green front at u+a_b qualifies at >= u+501 > w. Button points u+10/300/499 and u1+10/300 removed from the norm

expected: SafetyFault TRUE not later than w+1 (NV until symbol, A8)
abort sequence scan-identical to the same abort with FBK ON

criteria.events: FBK never / pulse ON u+1..u+199; green 600 ms with front u+a_b, a_b in {10, 300, 499} (invalid by ABORT-GREEN-CLR)

events: (a) green 600 ms, g0 in {rb+10, rb+300, rb+1999}
(b) green from rb+1999 held to rb+3000
(c) green rb+300 for 600 ms, then a new green at g0+600+1999 for 600 ms (also invalid)
then Faulty FALSE at h = max(end of last green, rb+3500)+1000
expected: every scan [g0, h-1]: (05) STO released, C2 ON, no SS1, no Discharge, status StartingRun; (06) C1 ON, out_LV_Discharge_Request FALSE, status Safe->R&D
after h: (05) Run per RUN-CONF-T, none <= h+99, present at h+101; (06) R&D per RND-CONF-T likewise

criteria.rule: current-e2a-dis-hold ISSUE 'STP-006 abort StartingRun' and current-e2b-cover-transitions 'IL-05d(1) ... aborted by green 600 ms': OFF 200 after BOTH makes the green invalid (g0 = rb+200) -> false RED on a correct candidate. Replace with OFF >= 2001 ms (recommended 2100, as E2-01 / KF-4), then GREEN 600. Other inputs and oracles unchanged
criteria.remark: current-e2c-stp-i 'green 600 ms pressed during the abort (c=u+50, press c+10)': the press is the BOTH remainder (before p+1100), not a fresh green; oracle 'not executed' valid under any reading; name misleading. A fresh valid green during STP-I abort is unreachable by button (abort ends ~Q+1100..1500, g0 >= Q+2101); CMD variant is E4
